versions.text: Criterion: Verify that buffet characteristics have been defined and assessed for safety of flight. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within MIL-STD-1797, 5.2.1.2 Buffet. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, simulation, and inspection of process, requirements, design, test, and configuration documentation.

Standard: The effect of buffet does not result in flying qualities worse than Level 2. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess normal acceleration excursions about trim at the pilot station as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Buffet paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the air vehicle handling qualities in buffet conditions as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Buffet paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the air vehicle handling qualities in buffet conditions for selected combinations of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions.
